title: Repository graph integrity layer
description: Model the issue set as a graph as a whole, in addition to per-issue validation: preserve DAG structure (r[graph-acyclic]), no broken links (r[no-broken-links]), detect index/file inconsistency (r[index-consistent]), and schema-compliance of issue files (r[schema-valid-issues]). This is also the natural layer to read all files once per invocation and reuse them from memory instead of rereading per query. SPEC section 'Repository Graph Integrity' traces the invariants; children implement and enforce them.
